title: Residency Call Scheduling Software | Done For You
description: Residency call scheduling software that takes the burden off the chief. We are a managed service: send us your rules and we deliver a fair call schedule, built to the ACGME rules.
paragraph: Stop spending nights building call schedules. Scheduling Wizard is a managed service, not complex software. Submit your rules and get a fair, ACGME-compliant residency call schedule.

cta.title: Stop Building Call Schedules by Hand
cta.description: Join 30+ departments across 20+ hospitals and practices who have outsourced call scheduling to Scheduling Wizard. Finished schedules in your format, with redrafts through the year included.

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard is not traditional self-service call scheduling software; it is a managed service. Rather than giving your chief residents a tool to learn and operate, Scheduling Wizard accepts your program's rules and delivers a finished, optimized call schedule as an Excel file. There is no platform to log into, no training required, and no annual retraining when chiefs rotate out.
faq.question: What is residency call scheduling software and how does Scheduling Wizard differ?

faq.answer: We apply the ACGME rules while the call schedule is built rather than checking it afterwards: the 80-hour weekly limit, rest requirements between shifts, the 24-hour cap and the subspecialty-specific rules for your program. We work from the requirements your program tells us apply, and we redraft when something needs to change.
faq.question: How does Scheduling Wizard ensure ACGME duty hour compliance in call schedules?

faq.answer: Yes. Our team has subspecialty-specific ACGME rule knowledge built in. Subspecialty-specific rules are among the most common questions on sales calls, and our team is designed to accommodate the distinct duty hour and call requirements that differ across specialties. When you submit your rules, your specialty's specific rules are applied to every call schedule generated.
faq.question: Can Scheduling Wizard handle call schedules for my specific medical subspecialty?

faq.answer: Yes, and many Scheduling Wizard clients use exactly this combination. Scheduling Wizard handles the creation and optimization of your call schedule. The finished schedule is delivered as an Excel file that your program can upload directly into whatever platform you already usese for day-to-day schedule access. You do not need to change your existing viewing workflow.
faq.question: Will Scheduling Wizard work alongside your existing platform?

faq.answer: Mid-year changes such as sick leave, emergency absences, or swap requests are handled as part of the managed service. Scheduling Wizard processes the updated rules and re-optimizes the affected portion of the call schedule without disrupting the rest of the year. Your program receives an updated Excel file rather than spending hours manually reshuffling assignments.
faq.question: What happens when a resident needs a last-minute call schedule change?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard primarily serves chief residents, program directors, program coordinators, and GME offices at residency and fellowship programs. Chief residents benefit most from not having to build or maintain call schedules themselves. Program directors benefit from ACGME compliance confidence and the elimination of annual knowledge loss when chiefs rotate out. Scheduling Wizard is currently serving 30+ departments across 20+ hospitals and practices.

items.title: Fair Call Schedules, Built
items.description: Our team produces ACGME-compliant on-call schedules that distribute call, weekend, and holiday burden equitably across all residents, respecting duty hour limits, post-call rest rules, and individual rules automatically.

items.title: Requirements Built In From the Start
items.description: ACGME duty hour rules are applied as the call schedule is built, including the 80-hour weekly limit, rest requirements, and the 24-hour cap. Subspecialty-specific rules are built into the schedule itself, so the rules are applied as we build, not discovered after publishing.

items.title: Done For You Scheduling Delivery
items.description: There is no platform to log into and no software to train your chiefs on. Submit your rules, and Scheduling Wizard's expert schedulers deliver a finished call schedule as an Excel file ready to upload to your existing publishing platform. The schedules are built by mathematicians who do this full time and nothing else.

items.title: Scheduling Knowledge Persists Year Over Year
highlights: New chiefs start with a working schedule
items.description: Your program's rules, requests, and scheduling configurations stay with Scheduling Wizard. When new chiefs take over, they inherit a working optimized system instead of rebuilding the call schedule from a blank spreadsheet.

items.title: Preferences Factored Into Every Call Schedule

Or a custom live view we build for you

items.description: Schedules come back in the format your program asks for, as Excel or Google Sheets, or on a custom live view we build for you.
